item.title: [github_trending] DietrichGebert/ponytail
item.description: Ponytail is an open-source project that pushes AI coding agents to behave like the 'laziest senior dev'—write only the minimum, and one line if that's enough. It's published as the npm package @dietrichgebert/ponytail and the README badge claims compatibility with 20 agents. Useful for developers who want AI to write less, not more.

item.title: [infoq] 一个忘关的开关，与企业Agent的全栈技术账单
item.description: At the enterprise Agent forum of the Yunqi Conference, Geekbang founder Huo Taiwen described an AI app whose token bill hit roughly ¥30,000 instead of an estimated ¥10,000 because a switch was left on, discovered only at month-end settlement. The article uses this to argue that enterprise Agents need permission checks, budget limits and cost attribution built into the stack, not just stronger models.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 用 kite 让 Claude Code 自己开会话派活给别的 Claude Code，记录一下今天实际跑的情况
item.description: On V2EX, a developer describes using kite's MCP so one Claude Code session could spawn several more on his Ubuntu machine, splitting work across a voice-model migration, fixes to his robin project tool, and kite itself, with merge and release gated on his approval. He also lists real friction, including missed confirmation pushes, a ten-minute timeout, and parent sessions unaware of child progress.

item.title: [infoq] 首发！openJiuwen workSwarm全双工多模态 ，像聊天一样与Agent交互，昇腾算力原生亲和
item.description: openJiuwen, an open-source AI agent platform, has released WorkSwarm, an office and coding workbench that runs real-time audio/video interaction and a background Core Agent inside the same task. Users can interrupt the agent mid-speech or hand off slower work such as research and document generation to the Core Agent. Built by Huawei's 2012 Lab and other teams, it ships one-click installers for Windows, Mac and HarmonyOS.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek 开源昇腾平台基础设施组件，覆盖 TileLang、计算库与分布式通信库
item.description: On September 30, DeepSeek open-sourced a set of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend platform, covering the TileLang compiler plus Ascend implementations of DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, FlashMLA and DeepSelect that map one-to-one onto its earlier NVIDIA releases. The team also worked with Huawei on a 128-card supernode based on Ascend 950. TileLang already implements most operators used in DeepSeek V4 training, and some components keep NVIDIA-level APIs to ease migration.

item.description: DecisionsApi is a developer-facing AI platform with an online playground and an API for testing decision models and wiring them into product flows. Inputs can be text, JSON objects or text arrays, and questions fall into Choice, Score or Noul (yes/no) types, returning structured answers, probabilities, confidence and usage. It targets use cases like routing customer requests, picking an agent's next step, safety gates and human review: validate in the playground, then call the API.

item.description: QCon Shanghai 2026 runs 22–24 October, themed around engineering practice for the Harness AI era, with tracks on AI Native architecture, Agent Runtime, AI Infra and more. Zheng Zhong, solutions lead at Shengshu Technology, will speak in the AIGC content industrialization track about Vidu's multimodal model, covering character and scene consistency, reference-driven generation, streaming video generation and world models. He previously led solutions teams at ByteDance and Baidu AI Cloud.

item.title: [infoq] GitLab Duo 通过微软 Foundry 扩展自托管 AI 选项
item.description: GitLab extended its self-hosted GitLab Duo so it can run models deployed through Microsoft Foundry, including OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama and Mistral. The setup combines a self-managed GitLab instance, a self-hosted AI Gateway and Foundry model endpoints, and lets teams assign different models to different Duo features. It suits organizations with data residency, sovereignty or network isolation needs, though model deployment, capacity and lifecycle operations shift to their own pla

item.title: [infoq] 谷歌开源面向自主 AI 代理的 Kubernetes 风格编排器 AX
item.description: Google open-sourced AX (hosted at agentexecutor.io and GitHub google/ax) under Apache 2.0, an orchestrator that runs autonomous agents as stateful actors on Agent Substrate with sub-second suspend and resume and no cold starts. Its control plane defines four declarative primitives — Task, Workspace, Gateway and Model — under ax.io/v1alpha1, driven by a Go-based ax CLI, with the control plane deployed to Kubernetes via ko and Redis in the ax-system namespace.

item.title: [infoq] 刚刚，Gemini 4 Argon 发布：多项基测碾压 GPT-6 Astra，已参与谷歌 80 万行内核代码迁移
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, aimed at long-horizon software engineering, legal and financial enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, with CEO Sundar Pichai unveiling it on X. The output cap rises from 64K to 1M tokens, and it is first available to vetted cyber-defense teams through the Fairwind program. Google reports 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 and first place on Zapier's AutomationBench at 51.3%.

item.title: [infoq] Uber 使用子集群重新设计 M3DB 分片策略，降低故障影响
item.description: Uber redesigned shard placement in M3DB, its distributed time-series database, by grouping nodes into fixed-size subclusters that own non-overlapping shard ranges while replicas stay spread across isolation groups. In the old model a single node failure could touch as many as (n-1)/n of the cluster; the new design confines failures, maintenance and scaling to one subcluster, at the cost of requiring equal instance weights and bulk, subcluster-sized expansion.

item.title: [juejin] 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
item.description: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] [CCProgress] 给 Claude Code 加了一个进度条， 长任务时能看到走到哪一步
item.description: CCProgress is a plugin that adds a progress bar to Claude Code, built by a self-described heavy user who says he burns 15 billion tokens a month and often hands long tasks to Claude Opus. The pain point: once a task is running there is no way to see how far along it is beyond inferring from outputs and tool calls, and the session feels unsafe to stop. Code is on GitHub at amigoer/ccprogress.

item.title: [infoq] 从 AI 试点到营收增长：Snowflake 销售与营销团队如何跨越落地鸿沟 ｜ 技术实践
item.description: Snowflake has published The GTM Leader's Blueprint for AI Transformation, documenting how its own sales and marketing teams apply AI across the customer lifecycle to drive revenue. Its main finding is that the bottleneck is organizational rather than technical: the two functions optimize different goals and rely on different data, so AI only makes the split more visible. Shared data and redesigned cross-team workflows are needed before local productivity gains turn into pipeline.

item.title: [github_trending] mattpocock/skills
item.description: Matt Pocock open-sourced his personal AI agent skills in mattpocock/skills, taken from his own .agents directory and used for real engineering, not vibe coding. Unlike frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit that own the whole process, these skills are deliberately small, adaptable, composable, and model-agnostic, giving developers more control. He encourages hacking on them and making them your own.

item.title: [github_trending] pbakaus/impeccable
item.description: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents, shipping one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 61 deterministic detector rules; install it with npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init to record product facts in PRODUCT.md. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and targets AI-generated clichés such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards.

item.title: [github_trending] mvschwarz/openrig
item.description: OpenRig is an open-source tool (npm: @openrig/cli) that lets you declare a team of coding agents — Claude Code, Codex and Pi in the same rig — in YAML and boot it with one command. Members get persistent roles, shared context and owned work, and a lead agent coordinates specialists on your behalf. It targets developers who want durable multi-agent collaboration instead of a pile of terminal sessions.

item.title: [github_trending] Panniantong/Agent-Reach
item.description: Agent Reach is an MIT-licensed Python CLI (3.10+) that lets an AI agent read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paying API fees. It targets developers who want live social and video platform data in their agents without maintaining each integration themselves.

item.title: [hackernews] Livenerf: Has Opus 5.5 been nerfed yet?
item.description: Livenerf (repo ninjahawk/livenerf) is a benchmark for tracking a model's capability after release, framed by the title's question of whether Opus 5.5 has been nerfed. It targets the case where a shipped model is quietly changed and no longer performs as it did at launch, useful for developers watching for capability drift between releases.

item.title: [github_trending] pablostanley/yoinks
item.description: yoinks is a terminal video downloader installed via npm or run directly with npx, pulling from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and 1,800+ other sites. Paste a URL, pick a resolution or audio-only mp3 in a full-screen picker, and let it fetch yt-dlp and ffmpeg automatically; only Node 18+ is needed. It suits developers who want downloads without popups, fake buttons or shady redirects.

item.title: [github_trending] NVIDIA/OpenShell
item.description: NVIDIA has open-sourced OpenShell, described as a safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents, Apache-2.0 licensed and published on PyPI. The 0.1.x line adds a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface and new APIs. It targets teams that need to run many agents inside an isolated, private environment.

item.title: [github_trending] heygen-com/hyperframes
item.description: HyperFrames is an open-source project from HeyGen that turns HTML into rendered video and is pitched as "built for agents"; it ships as the npm package hyperframes, requires Node.js 22 or newer and is Apache 2.0 licensed. With a quickstart and showcase available, it targets developers who want to produce video through code or automated agent pipelines rather than timeline editors.

item.title: [github_trending] obra/superpowers
item.description: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built on composable skills plus initial instructions your agent is meant to follow. Its README documents setup for many coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI. It targets developers who want their coding agent to follow a repeatable engineering process instead of improvising.
